title: Unsupervised learning for the systematic identification of nondispersive wave packets in driven helium
summary: Nondispersive wave packets in driven helium are long-lived quantum states that follow classical resonant orbits without spreading. Their identification typically requires detailed analysis of phase-space structures and extensive exploration of parameter regimes. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised learning approach to automate the identification of physically relevant states in the driven helium atom.
